meta.descPoolGame: Play 8-ball pool online for free: a 3D table, aim guide, three computer levels or two players on one device. Runs in your browser, nothing to install.

pool-game.name: Pool game
pool-game.blurb: 8-ball on a 3D table, against the computer or a friend.

pool-game.a1: Break the rack, then pot all of your group — solids (1–7) or stripes (9–15) — and finally the black 8. Your group is set by the first ball you pot after the break. Potting the 8 before your group is cleared, or on a foul, loses the game.
pool-game.q2: How do I aim and shoot?
pool-game.a2: Drag on the table to aim: in top view the cue points where you touch, and in the 3D view you drag sideways to turn. The white line and ghost ball show where the cue ball hits and a coloured line where the object ball goes; aim help can also show the full paths, or be turned off. Set the power with the slider or Up and Down, tap the cue ball picture for spin, then press Shoot or Space. Left and Right turn the cue (hold Shift for small steps).
pool-game.a3: Potting the cue ball, missing every ball, hitting the other group (or the 8 too early) first, and a shot where no ball is potted and none reaches a cushion after the first contact. After a foul the other player has ball in hand anywhere; after a scratch on the break it is behind the head string, and a ball behind that line may not be hit first.
pool-game.a4: Easy, Medium and Hard look for makeable pots and safeties with the same physics you play with and test each one in a simulation before shooting; the easier levels aim less precisely.
pool-game.a5: Yes. The game in progress and your wins and losses against the computer stay in this browser, so you can come back to a game later. Nothing is sent anywhere.
pool-game.q6: Can I play other pool games on this table?
pool-game.a6: Yes. Pick another game above the table: 9-ball, 10-ball, Chinese 8-ball, snooker, Russian pyramid or three-cushion. The billiards and snooker pages explain the rules of each.

pool-game.s1b: Press Play, aim at the rack and shoot hard to spread the balls.
pool-game.s2b: Drag on the table to aim, set the power and shoot. Your first pot after the break decides solids or stripes.
pool-game.s3b: Clear your group, then pot the black 8 to win. Avoid fouls: they give your opponent ball in hand.
